basic_details.job_title: IAV Laboratory Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Advanced Virology (IAV), an institution under the Science & Technology Department of Government of Keralam, has invited online applications for one temporary Laboratory Manager post at its Advanced Molecular Diagnostic Facility (MDF), on a consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/- per month and an initial appointment of one year. Applicants need a graduate degree with minimum 50% marks in Virology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Medical Laboratory Technology, an MBA in Marketing/Supply chain management and minimum five years' experience in operational management of diagnostic laboratories of

how_to_apply: Submit the online application through the link printed in the notice, https://forms.gle/X8NcAXimmdGqbKbcA, by 7th December 2026, 05.00 PM.
Provide a valid e-mail ID, because all correspondence on this appointment is through e-mail only.

Submit the CGPA/Grade to % conversion formula (issued by the competent authority) for the degree awarding institution along with the application, where grading other than % is used and the formula is not already in the certificate/mark sheet.

The notice gives no separate last date for fee payment.
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form is not permitted, and any interim enquiry will not be entertained. Advanced Molecular Diagnostic Facility (MDF) of the institute

content_sections.heading: About IAV
content_sections.text: The Institute of Advanced Virology is an institution under the Science & Technology Department of Government of Keralam, with a focus on cutting-edge research initiatives in virology. Its Advanced Molecular Diagnostic Facility is the public face of the Institute and functions as a referral laboratory for virus diagnostics in the state. The facility has the capacity to diagnose about 88 virus parameters, including major emerging virus infections.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints three minimum essential qualifications for the single Laboratory Manager post. Age: 40 years as on 23.11.2026. All educational qualification certificates must be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. Experience is counted from the date of acquiring the prescribed minimum essential educational qualification. Only candidates fulfilling all the essential qualifications, and qualifying the screening by a duly constituted screening committee, will be short-listed for further selection. The notice prints no desirable qualification and no age relaxation.

rows.minimum_essential_qualification: i. Graduate Degree (with minimum 50% marks) in Virology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Medical Laboratory Technology. ii. MBA in Marketing/Supply chain management. iii. Minimum five years' experience in Operational Management of diagnostic laboratories of Govt. organisations/Public Sector organisations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 40,000/- per month (consolidated). The initial appointment will be for one year, and subsequent extensions will be based on performance and approval from the competent authority of the Institute. The position is purely temporary, and selection will not entitle the candidate to any claim for future positions at IAV (permanent or otherwise). Selected candidates are required to join within 15 days from the date of the appointment order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IAV Laboratory Manager
content_sections.text: Submit the online application through the link printed in the notice, https://forms.gle/X8NcAXimmdGqbKbcA , by 7th December 2026, 05.00 PM. Provide a valid e-mail ID, because all correspondence on this appointment is through e-mail only. Submit the CGPA/Grade to % conversion formula (issued by the competent authority) for the degree awarding institution along with the application, where grading other than % is used and the formula is not already in the certificate/mark sheet. Pay the application fee of Rs. 200 + GST through SB collect: login to https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm . Select Educational Institutions, then Institute of Advanced Virology, then Fees Recruitment, and make payment for Rs.236/-. The notice gives no separate last date for fee payment.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are first screened by a duly constituted screening committee. Only candidates who fulfil all the essential qualifications and qualify the screening are short-listed. The short-listed candidates will be selected through a selection process comprising a written test and/or interview. The notice gives no date, venue or syllabus for these stages. Amendments to the notification (if any) and the results will be published on the website of the institute.

Applicants should regularly check the institute's website for amendments and results.
